resources.string: This month\'s gym days and your last session

string-array.name: health_rationale_lines
string-array.item: GYMTRX reads your daily step count to show it on rest days in your calendar.

If you said you wear a watch, it also reads heart rate and active calories for the time you were at the gym, your sleep, workouts recorded by your watch app (to find when you trained) and weigh-ins from other apps such as a smart scale.
If you turn on sharing, it writes your gym sessions as strength-training workouts and the weigh-ins you type in GYMTRX.
Everything stays on your phone. GYMTRX has no server and never sends health data anywhere.
Change or remove access any time in Health Connect, or in GYMTRX under Settings → Health Connect.
